توضح هذه السياسة كيف تجمع منصة DEV MENU: This policy explains how DEV MENU collects, uses and protects data, in line with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law.
البيانات التي نجمعها من أصحاب المتاجر: Data we collect from store owners
البريد الإلكتروني، ويُستخدم لتسجيل الدخو: Email, used to sign in with a verification code.
رقم الجوال، ويُستخدم للتواصل بخصوص الاشت: Phone number, used to contact you about your subscription and support.
محتوى المنيو الذي تضيفه: الأطباق والأسعا: The menu content you add: dishes, prices, photos, logo, contact links and business details.
لا نطلب من زوار المنيو تسجيل الدخول، ولا: Menu visitors don't sign in, and we don't collect their names or numbers. We only count how many times the menu is opened and how often each dish is viewed, fully anonymously and not linked to anyone, to show stats to the store owner.
عند اختيار الزائر \"اطلب عبر واتساب\"، ت: When a visitor chooses "Order via WhatsApp", the chat goes straight to WhatsApp between them and the business, and doesn't pass through our platform.
عند التسجيل في قائمة انتظار إحدى المنشآت: When you join a business's waitlist, we keep the details that business asks for (such as name, phone, email and party size) to manage your turn and send confirmation and turn alerts. This data belongs to the business, which can view and download it only to serve its guests. To have your data removed from a business's records, contact the business or us.
Running your account and showing your menu to customers.
Sending verification codes and subscription alerts.
Technical support and improving the platform.
لا نبيع بياناتك ولا نشاركها مع أي جهة لأ: We don't sell your data or share it with anyone for marketing.
تُحفظ البيانات لدى مزودي خدمات سحابية مو: Data is stored with trusted cloud providers, and access to each store's data is limited to its owner and the platform administrators. Data travels over an encrypted connection.
نحتفظ ببياناتك طالما حسابك قائم. يمكنك ط: We keep your data as long as your account exists. You can ask us to permanently delete your store and all its data at any time, and it will be deleted within 30 days.
الاطلاع على بياناتك والحصول على نسخة منه: View your data and get a copy of it.
